s: precise, farm-driven tasting menus that put it among North America's very best
w: A quiet, intensely focused West Loop tasting-menu restaurant built around ingredients from the chefs' own farm downstate. The cooking favours precision over spectacle -- vegetables, game and dairy pushed through fermentation and long technique rather than showy plating -- and it's climbed to the top of recent North American best-restaurant rankings on the strength of consistency rather than hype.
_facts: Located at 177 N Ada St, Chicago, IL 60607, in the West Loop
Run by chefs John Shields and Karen Urie Shields
Sources much of its produce and dairy from the couple's own farm in Michigan
Ranked among the top restaurants in North America's 50 Best Restaurants list
